definition: a person walking in the street, not driving
description: A Japanese city street. A woman in a coral trouser suit with a white shoulder bag walks across the white-barred crossing towards the camera while a black van waits at the red light and the walk signal shows green; other people on foot cross the side street behind her. The camera then rises high above a huge scramble junction, showing her alone in the middle of the painted bars, and finally the same junction with hundreds of people on foot streaming across it in every direction while the cars stand still.
